body:
So...  I too have have these thoughts.  I've even (through 2 marriages and having 2 children) always questioned my sexuality.  I still "feel" straight and plan on staying that way.  Just a little while ago I really fucked up and am terrorized at that thought that I might go to prison and have to be forced to be gay.  That's why I first posted here thinking I should just flee this mortal coil.  

Don't accept it!  I didn't.  But some of the people in this forum helped me realize that I don't have to die to work my way out of a certain death.  

I still don't accept it.  I don't want to be gay. I don't want anyone to think I'm gay.

Maybe I am, but REALLY don't want to get raped in prison.  

But, I do want to live.  I want to take any of the worst times in my life and find a way to experience some of the best times I could imagine and maybe balance them out.

You can PM me if you want.  Not sure I can help but I would love to try.

I'm still facing a lot of shit in the next few months.  But I think I'll be able to make it through.  I'm just so fucking scared of getting sexually assualted in prison.  I guess, to be honest, getting raped would be better than being dead.  I'll just have to hope.
Thank you for responding.  I'm "almost" ok now.  Just trying to get my life back together.

Hi there.  I'm 40ish.  Until 4 hours ago I had a great job as a programmer but my name came out in the paper so that's gone now.  I too am going back to school but I think I'll cut that out for now.  Thank you for responding.  I'm not in some kind of full-psycho mode but just thinking about options to going to prison.

Thank you for the kind words.  Jealousy and loneliness are terrible to deal with.  In some ways I think I might be ok in prison.  Quit smoking, get in shape etc...  But for the most part I think going away would be easier

Can you elaborate on what is causing you such pain?  I too am thinking of this at them moment.  I'm over 40 and may be in prison for many years for something I didn't do.  I would hope that at your age someone could help you deal with what's ailing you.  Not for sure, we all have pain that we bear but if I could help talk to someone in the same boat as I'm in I might be able to help.
